# Vipākattika (Patthana 13.3)

**ID:** Patthana 13.3
**Section:** Patthana (patthana)
**Collection:** Abhidhamma
**Title (Pali):** Vipākattika
**tipitaka.org (CST):** https://tipitaka.org/romn/cscd/abh03m11.mul8.xml

## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

The *Vipākattika* ("Triad on Karmic Results" or "The Triad 'karmically resultant, etc.'") constitutes section 13.3 of the *Paṭṭhāna*, the seventh book of the Theravāda Abhidhamma Piṭaka [Catalog; Nyanatiloka 2007a]. In systematic Abhidhamma analysis, the *vipāka-ttika* forms the third of the twenty-two primary triads (*tika*) of the Abhidhamma mātikā, analyzing conditional relations among phenomena that are karmic results, those that produce karmic results, and those that are neither [Nyanatiloka 2007a; Nyanatiloka 2007b].

**Sources**

- [Nyanatiloka 2007a] Nyanatiloka Mahāthera, Guide Through the Abhidhamma Piṭaka (1938, repr. 2007) — Structural outline of the 22 triads in the Paṭṭhāna and English rendering of Vipāka-ttika.
- [Nyanatiloka 2007b] Nyanatiloka Mahāthera, Guide Through the Abhidhamma Piṭaka (1938, repr. 2007) — Corroboration of the triad's placement and title in the Paṭṭhāna.
